fullText.simplified:
五、怒龙出湖

    洞庭龙王通过龙女的一滴眼泪变成的珍珠，知道了所有的事情。
    柳毅现在才知道那颗珍珠的好处，不用他多说一个字，龙女就用她的一滴泪把所有事情都告诉给龙王了。看到龙王既生气又难过的样子，柳毅也觉得有些悲伤。
    “龙王，您别太难过。现在最重要的事情，是想办法把龙姑娘接回来。”柳毅说。
    龙王这才好好看向柳毅，见到他累极了的样子，就知道他从泾阳回来一路十分辛苦，于是感动地说：“泾河是有名的大河，泾河龙王法力高强，我和龙儿母亲都以为他们一家是好人，所以才让龙儿和小泾河君结婚。龙儿刚结婚时，我们听说她在那边过得不错，后来联系慢慢变少了。我们还以为是她过得很幸福，所以没有和我们联系。谢谢你送信来，如果没有你，我们还不知道她正在那边受苦。我们会接龙儿回来的，你放心吧。”
    这时，窗户外面突然一声大响，像是房子要倒了，接着有人大声叫道：“泾河一家，太过分了！哥哥，你在家等着，我现在就去把我们的宝贝龙儿接回来！”
    说话的同时，只见窗外金光闪闪，一个人影像闪电一样向翻滚的湖面飞了上去。
    柳毅大惊，龙王也吓了一跳，忙向外面叫道：“弟弟小心，只用把龙儿接回来就可以了！不要杀人！”但那个人早就飞远了，哪里还听得到龙王的声音？
    “这是谁？”柳毅问。
    龙王叹息说：“这是我弟弟钱塘君，他的家在钱塘江，这几天来洞庭看我。他很喜欢龙儿，看着龙儿长大，比我这个父亲还爱她。刚刚他应该也看到了龙儿的眼泪，所以才这么生气，立刻要去接龙儿。”
    “他就是江南三大名江，钱塘江的钱塘龙王吗？”柳毅吃惊极了，但马上又问：“虽然钱塘龙王很有名，但他一个人能把龙姑娘带回来吗？”
    “没错，我弟弟就是有名的钱塘龙王。放心，他的法力是龙王里面最高强的，泾河龙王一家打不过他的。但他脾气有些暴躁，我只希望他不要因为太生气，而把泾河龙王的儿子杀了。”
    “……这……您要不要追上去看看？”
    “不用了，钱塘君一天可以飞一千里，现在他应该快到泾阳了，我追不上他了。”
    柳毅吃惊极了，从泾阳到洞庭，他走了两个月，现在钱塘君居然只在几句话的时间里就能到泾阳，这真的是只有神仙才能做到的事。看来这个钱塘君真的能把龙女带回来了。想到这里，柳毅就放心了。
fullText.traditional:
五、怒龍出湖

    洞庭龍王通過龍女的一滴眼淚變成的珍珠，知道了所有的事情。
    柳毅現在才知道那顆珍珠的好處，不用他多說一個字，龍女就用她的一滴淚把所有事情都告訴給龍王了。看到龍王既生氣又難過的樣子，柳毅也覺得有些悲傷。
    “龍王，您別太難過。現在最重要的事情，是想辦法把龍姑娘接回來。”柳毅說。
    龍王這才好好看向柳毅，見到他累極了的樣子，就知道他從涇陽回來一路十分辛苦，於是感動地說：“涇河是有名的大河，涇河龍王法力高強，我和龍兒母親都以為他們一家是好人，所以才讓龍兒和小涇河君結婚。龍兒剛結婚時，我們聽說她在那邊過得不錯，後來聯繫慢慢變少了。我們還以為是她過得很幸福，所以沒有和我們聯繫。謝謝你送信來，如果沒有你，我們還不知道她正在那邊受苦。我們會接龍兒回來的，你放心吧。”
    這時，窗戶外面突然一聲大響，像是房子要倒了，接著有人大聲叫道：“涇河一家，太過分了！哥哥，你在家等著，我現在就去把我們的寶貝龍兒接回來！”
    說話的同時，只見窗外金光閃閃，一個人影像閃電一樣向翻滾的湖面飛了上去。
    柳毅大驚，龍王也嚇了一跳，忙向外面叫道：“弟弟小心，只用把龍兒接回來就可以了！不要殺人！”但那個人早就飛遠了，哪裡還聽得到龍王的聲音？
    “這是誰？”柳毅問。
    龍王嘆息說：“這是我弟弟錢塘君，他的家在錢塘江，這幾天來洞庭看我。他很喜歡龍兒，看著龍兒長大，比我這個父親還愛她。剛剛他應該也看到了龍兒的眼淚，所以才這麼生氣，立刻要去接龍兒。”
    “他就是江南三大名江，錢塘江的錢塘龍王嗎？”柳毅吃驚極了，但馬上又問：“雖然錢塘龍王很有名，但他一個人能把龍姑娘帶回來嗎？”
    “沒錯，我弟弟就是有名的錢塘龍王。放心，他的法力是龍王裡面最高強的，涇河龍王一家打不過他的。但他脾氣有些暴躁，我只希望他不要因為太生氣，而把涇河龍王的兒子殺了。”
    “……這……您要不要追上去看看？”
    “不用了，錢塘君一天可以飛一千里，現在他應該快到涇陽了，我追不上他了。”
    柳毅吃驚極了，從涇陽到洞庭，他走了兩個月，現在錢塘君居然只在幾句話的時間裡就能到涇陽，這真的是只有神仙才能做到的事。看來這個錢塘君真的能把龍女帶回來了。想到這裡，柳毅就放心了。

sentences.english: But he has quite a bad temper.

sentences.simplified: 我只希望他不要因为太生气，而把泾河龙王的儿子杀了。”
sentences.traditional: 我只希望他不要因為太生氣，而把涇河龍王的兒子殺了。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ xī wàng tā bú yào yīn wèi tài shēng qì ér bǎ jīng hé lóng wáng de ér zi shā le
sentences.english: I just hope he doesn’t get so angry that he ends up killing the son of the Dragon King of the Jing River.”

sentences.simplified: “……这……您要不要追上去看看？”
sentences.traditional: “……這……您要不要追上去看看？”
sentences.pinyin: zhè nín yào bú yào zhuī shàng qù kàn kan
sentences.english: “… Um … would you like to go after him and see?”

sentences.simplified: “不用了，钱塘君一天可以飞一千里，
sentences.traditional: “不用了，錢塘君一天可以飛一千里，
sentences.pinyin: bú yòng le qián táng jūn yì tiān kě yǐ fēi yì qiān lǐ
sentences.english: “No, the Master of Qiantang can fly a thousand li in one day.

sentences.simplified: 现在他应该快到泾阳了，我追不上他了。”
sentences.traditional: 現在他應該快到涇陽了，我追不上他了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā yīng gāi kuài dào jīng yáng le wǒ zhuī bú shàng tā le
sentences.english: By now, he should be close to Jingyang. I won’t be able to catch up with him.”

sentences.simplified: 柳毅吃惊极了，从泾阳到洞庭，他走了两个月，
sentences.traditional: 柳毅吃驚極了，從涇陽到洞庭，他走了兩個月，
sentences.pinyin: liǔ yì chī jīng jí le cóng jīng yáng dào dòng tíng tā zǒu le liǎng ge yuè
sentences.english: Liu Yi was extremely surprised. It had taken him two months to travel from Jingyang to Dongting.

sentences.simplified: 现在钱塘君居然只在几句话的时间里就能到泾阳，
sentences.traditional: 現在錢塘君居然只在幾句話的時間裡就能到涇陽，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài qián táng jūn jū rán zhǐ zài jǐ jù huà de shí jiān lǐ jiù néng dào jīng yáng
sentences.english: Now, the Master of Qiantang could get to Jingyang in just the time it takes to say a few sentences.

sentences.simplified: 这真的是只有神仙才能做到的事。
sentences.traditional: 這真的是只有神仙才能做到的事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhēn de shì zhǐ yǒu shén xiān cái néng zuò dào de shì
sentences.english: This was truly something only an immortal could accomplish.

sentences.simplified: 看来这个钱塘君真的能把龙女带回来了。
sentences.traditional: 看來這個錢塘君真的能把龍女帶回來了。
sentences.pinyin: kàn lái zhè ge qián táng jūn zhēn de néng bǎ lóng nǚ dài huí lai le
sentences.english: It seemed that the Master of Qiantang would really be able to bring Longnü back.

sentences.simplified: 想到这里，柳毅就放心了。
sentences.traditional: 想到這裡，柳毅就放心了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ liǔ yì jiù fàng xīn le
sentences.english: Thinking about this, Liu Yi felt at ease.

sentence_translations: 5. The Angry Dragon Emerges From the Lake
The Dragon King of Dongting learned about everything through a pearl formed from Longnü’s teardrop.
Liu Yi now understood the benefit of that pearl.
Without him needing to say another word, Longnü used a single tear to tell the Dragon King everything.
Seeing the Dragon King both angry and sad, Liu Yi also felt quite sorrowful.
“Dragon King, don’t be too sad. The most important thing right now is to find a way to bring Miss Dragon back,” Liu Yi said.
It was only then that the Dragon King took a good look at Liu Yi.
Seeing how exhausted he was, the Dragon King knew he must have endured a lot of hardship on his journey back from Jingyang.
Moved, he said, “The Jing River is a famous great river, and the Dragon King of the Jing River has great magical power.
Long’er’s mother and I both thought that they were a good family, which is why we had Long’er marry the Young Master of the Jing River.
When Long’er first got married, we heard that she was doing well over there, but later, we contacted each other less and less.
We actually thought she was living happily, and that was why she didn’t contact us.
Thank you for delivering this letter. Without you, we wouldn’t have known that she is suffering over there.
We will bring Long’er back, don’t worry.”
At that moment, there was a sudden, loud noise outside the window, as if the house was about to collapse.
This was followed by someone shouting loudly:
“The Jing River family has gone too far! Elder brother, wait at home. I’m going to bring our precious Long’er back right now!”
As he spoke, a golden light flashed outside the window, ..
.. and a figure shot up toward the churning surface of the lake like a bolt of lightning.
Liu Yi was taken aback, and the Dragon King was startled too.
He hurriedly shouted outside, “Younger brother, be careful! Just bring Long’er back! No killing!”
However, the person had already flown far away. How could he still hear the Dragon King’s voice?
“Who was that?” Liu Yi asked.
The Dragon King sighed and said, “That was my younger brother, the Master of Qiantang.
His home is in the Qiantang River. He has come to Dongting to visit me these past few days.
He really likes Long’er. He watched her grow up, and loves her even more than I, her father, does.
He must have seen Long’er’s tear just now, which is why he got so angry and immediately wanted to go bring Long’er back.”
“He’s the Dragon King of Qiantang, from the Qiantang River, one of the three famous rivers in Jiangnan?”
Liu Yi was extremely surprised but quickly asked, ..
.. “The Dragon King of Qiantang is very famous, but will he be able to bring back Miss Dragon by himself?”
“That’s right, my younger brother is the famous Dragon King of Qiantang.
Rest assured, his magical power is the strongest among the Dragon Kings.
The Dragon King of the Jing River’s family is no match for him.
But he has quite a bad temper.
I just hope he doesn’t get so angry that he ends up killing the son of the Dragon King of the Jing River.”
“… Um … would you like to go after him and see?”
“No, the Master of Qiantang can fly a thousand li in one day.
By now, he should be close to Jingyang. I won’t be able to catch up with him.”
Liu Yi was extremely surprised. It had taken him two months to travel from Jingyang to Dongting.
Now, the Master of Qiantang could get to Jingyang in just the time it takes to say a few sentences.
This was truly something only an immortal could accomplish.
It seemed that the Master of Qiantang would really be able to bring Longnü back.
Thinking about this, Liu Yi felt at ease.
